description_expanded: A Shore Thing – 30A Gulf-Front Gem Favorite Features: - Beachfront - Private Beach Access - Complimentary Beach Service (In-Season) About A Shore Thing: Welcome to your front-row seat to the Gulf. This beautifully renovated beachfront home sits closer to the sand than almost any other house nearby — over 100 feet closer than neighboring homes — giving you unmatched views and the feeling of being right on the water. Fresh off a $300,000 top-to-bottom renovation, virtually everything in the home is brand new, including the kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, paint, shiplap walls, furniture, and décor. Massive windows stretch across the Gulf side of the home, filling the space with natural light and breathtaking views of the emerald water and white sand beaches. Perfectly sized for families and small groups, the home comfortably sleeps up to 8 guests with: - 1 King bedroom - 1 Queen bedroom - 1 fun bunk room that sleeps 4 Located directly beside a beach access, you’ll enjoy the energy and excitement of the beach while still having your own private Gulf-front retreat. Walk from your deck straight onto the sand in seconds, spend the day watching the waves roll in, and end the evening with unforgettable sunsets right outside your window. If you’re looking for a luxury beachfront getaway where everything feels brand new and the beach truly feels like your backyard, this is it.
